senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; צָלַל) [precipitous declivity,] glen, shaft, fish-pond.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 67a:7">B. Bath. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>חולסית ומ׳</he> a sand-mound (for glass-making) and a glen (shaft for metal-digging; oth. opin. fish-pond); <cite ref="Arakhin 32a">Arakh. 32ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Megillah 6b:12">Meg. 6ᵇ</cite> (missing in editions revised by censors, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) <he>וצידו אחד חולסית ומ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="H01732"><he>חרסית</he></cite>) and on the fourth side it (Rome) is bounded by sand-hills (clay-ground) and glens (or shafts).—

<cite ref="Berakhot 9b">Ber. 9ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 119a:7">Pes. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>כמ׳ שאין בה דגה</he> (<he>דגים</he>) (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes) like a pond without fish (oth. vers., v. <cite ref="M02290">next w.</cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 154">Yalk. Gen. 154</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 204">Yalk. Kings 204</cite>; v. <cite ref="M02281"><he>מְצוּדָה</he></cite>. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 5 (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 15:5">Ex. XV, 5</cite>, a.

Jon. II, 4) יונה ירד למ׳ אחת וכ׳ Jonah went down into one whirlpool, but they (the Egyptians) into two; Yalk. Ex. 246.—Pl. מְצוּלוֹת, מְצוֹ׳. Mekh. l. c. ואין מ׳ אלא מים עזים m. means rapid waters; (Yalk. l. c. ואין מצולה וכ׳); a. e.
